pretreatments.description: Ozone pretreatment involves treating grass waste with ozone to degrade lignin and enhance biodegradation efficiency.
Sodium 2-bromoethanesulfonate (SAA) is applied to inhibit methanogens, improving substrate solubility and reducing structural barriers.
Ozone combined with SAA (OSAA) synergistically breaks down lignin and cellulose, optimizing hydrolysis and methane production.
Size reduction through milling increases surface area and enzymatic activity for efficient breakdown.
Enzymatic hydrolysis employs cellulase and β-glycosidase to degrade cellulose, boosting sugar recovery and biogas yield.
